# retrieval-debugger

> Explain why a document was or was not retrieved for a query: its rank against the cutoff, per-term exact, accent and stem matches, missing terms and terms cut off by chunking Python package `trysac-retrieval-debugger`, import name `retrieval_debugger`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
